sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The graph remains semantically unfaithful despite deterministic validity. Preserve the prior repair instructions and exact canonical nltl:bladePlasticBending with xsd:string on its authoritative ship owner. The three qualified hasComponent checks only assert component-class presence and do not state that each steering mechanism, thruster fitting, and thruster body is designed to withstand blade plastic bending without damage.
